# netactuate_tag (Resource)

Manages a Tag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_tag" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name. The platform lowercases it and replaces spaces with hyphens, so "My Tag" is stored as "my-tag".

### Optional

- `color` (String) Tag color
- `description` (String) Tag description
- `icon` (String) Tag icon
- `is_default` (Number) Default tag flag as a 0 or 1 integer, not a boolean
- `is_favorite` (Number) Favorite tag flag as a 0 or 1 integer, not a boolean
- `is_locked` (Number) Locked tag flag as a 0 or 1 integer, not a boolean
- `show_dashboard` (Number) Dashboard visibility flag as a 0 or 1 integer, not a boolean

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Tag creation timestamp
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mb_id` (Number) Account ID
- `resources` (List of Object) Resources assigned to the tag (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `resources_count` (Number) Number of resources assigned to the tag

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `identifier` (Number)
- `resource_name` (String)
- `resource_tag_id` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_tag.example 12345
```
